description: Process a full or partial refund for a completed order.

order_id.description: ID of the order to refund

amount.description: Refund amount; must be positive and not exceed original transaction amount

reason.description: Reason for the refund: customer_request, defective, not_as_described, duplicate, or other

refund_method.description: Refund delivery method: original, store_credit, or bank_transfer

line_items.description: Optional list of specific line items to refund; if omitted, full refund is assumed

item_id.description: ID of the line item being refunded

quantity.description: Number of units being refunded; must be positive

amount.description: Refund amount for this line item

customer_note.description: Optional note visible to the customer explaining the refund

internal_note.description: Optional internal note not visible to the customer

notify_customer.description: Whether to send the customer a refund confirmation notification; defaults to true

metadata.description: Optional metadata about the source of the refund request

source.description: System or channel that originated the refund (e.g. support_portal, api, backoffice)

agent_id.description: ID of the support agent who initiated the refund, if applicable
